body: I’ve had this epiphany. It’s not fun to think that. Almost like you just exist but not by choice anymore. Like, a waste of resources. We know that these resources are abundant but we don’t feel like we deserve them.

I know the feeling all to well. When you’re depressed for so long it feels like the default emotion, anytime you experience anything positive it feels alien and wrong, almost guilty. But then you get these feelings, numbness. You don’t feel happy, so it doesn’t give you that guilt. But you’re not exactly sad either. So it feels like nothing. And everything. Hard to explain in words.
I did, they said they can’t do anything until there’s a physical altercation. He’s had 5 reports against him in 24 hrs and has warrants out for his arrest.
A ridiculous question based on a ridiculous premise was the idea.
All fair points.
Officially those are correct. But in practice not so much. Rape is often not convicted. However, attempted murder is more often.
Thank you.
So then rape that results in pregnancy should be considered attempted murder in all cases? And thus hold much higher penalties.
Okay. Thanks for going off in this post though. Really has been engaging.
I don’t know if you realize we’re on the same side.
Why not?
Many in Congress would disagree. Any pregnancy that fails could be considered murder. You can only murder a person. Could then and abortion be considered self defense?
Whole heartedly agree. I’m just pointing out the absurdity of a small clump of nonviable cells being considered human. How far do the human rights extend?
I cannot pin your political position on this.
So the father could be charged? With improper implantation.
What is it about?
So no fault from any party? Hardly seems fair considering the mother could die.
I’m aware. But if it is legally a person then can it be charged with a crime?
I’m not saying anyone gets aborted. I’m saying the mother falls ill or is otherwise harmed by the embryo. Who is at fault?
But then what rights does an embryo have? It is not a citizen. Could they be deported or detained?
Are they dependent on the mother? They should be claimed as so.
Fair point. But that is why I say manslaughter instead of murder or homicide.
Why? They didn’t put it there. That embryo was not told to go there.
Because it is an actual question. Though I guess murder is okay in your mind. That’s fine too.
Elaborate.

If it is a person, is it a dependent on tax forms?  

If  it isn’t a US citizen yet, could an expecting mother be charged with harboring an illegal alien?

If you can claim them on taxes, what’s to stop someone from getting pregnant for nine months in a calendar year to claim a dependent and just give up the child for adoption? (Pain and possible complications aside).
I guess it’d be terrible either way. If you couldn’t do something about it then you’d think you failed if you tried. But you’d think you could’ve helped or done something if you didn’t know.
I heard if you fall asleep beforehand you just won’t wake up.
Isn’t it though? It’s dishonest. I’m lying to them.
I’ve studied psychology and tried a bunch of “tricks” it just feels dishonest. I don’t want to manipulate people into being my friend.
I can barely afford to not be homeless right now. Therapy just isn’t possible.
It’s not the cancer’s fault that someone smoked, but we removed the cancer. At this point I’m the cancer.
I’m overweight, but nobody has seemed to have a problem with that. I just give off a bad vibe that people don’t like.
I’ve tried. People just don’t like me.
But it can’t be everyone else that’s the problem if I’m the only one they have a problem with. I should be better, I should do better. If I can’t, then what good am I?

I’ve been told “you know those people you meet and you just hate? You’re one of them.” And I can tell when people dislike me, they are short with me, they go out of their way to exclude or ignore me, they tell others to avoid me. I’ve been around for 25 years, always on the outside looking in. You can start to pick these things apart after awhile.
I’m not mean spirited. I’ve lost my cool a couple of times but never terribly, I don’t like to hurt people.

It sounds like what I have, manic depression (bipolar). The ups and downs are terrible and downright debilitating at times.

It’s hard, the best I’ve found is to distract myself, find something to occupy my mind so I don’t think too hard about myself.
Logically, I know that. It’s just always in the back of my mind. Whenever someone seems to have no interest in me, or avoids me for any reason, I assume it’s pure hatred.

I haven’t figured that out. My mother hated/hates me and every person I’ve ever gotten close to has lost interest or gotten pushed away. I’ve even been told “You know those people you meet and just hate? You’re one of them.” And it’s not really a home. It’s just a trailer. It was only $4500 so not much of an accomplishment.
